TILE_AUTHORITY_SOURCE: Import/Ingolstadt/Ingolstadt.json maps[0] (tiles[] list + tile_size + map name) — the governed package descriptor already consumed by Import.py
why_not_asset_registry: Registry reflects post-import state (could include stale/extra worlds); the manifest is the pre-import declaration of intent. Registry is used only as cross-check, never as the iteration driver.
why_not_importsettings: importsetting.json carries FBX paths, not tile coordinates; coordinates live only in tile filenames + manifest list.
why_not_commandlet_params: PrepareAssetsForCooking takes only PackageName/OnlyPrepareMaps; no coordinate input exists (that absence IS the defect).
